original_ai_output.title_zh: 联合国妇女署：信息获取是终结暴力的关键
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国妇女署在阿布贾表示，缺乏及时准确的信息限制了女性参与治理、经济赋权及免受暴力侵害，农村社区尤为突出。该表态是在“告知女性、改变生活”运动及社区信息与倡导论坛上作出的，论坛旨在纪念国际普遍获取信息日。活动由阿布贾市政区委员会主办，为期一年，由卡特中心资助。

key_facts.fact: 联合国妇女署称缺乏及时准确信息限制了女性参与治理、经济赋权及免受暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The UN Women has said that lack of access to timely and accurate information is limiting women’s participation in governance, economic empowerment and protection from violence, particularly in rural communities.

key_facts.fact: 该表态由联合国妇女署尼日利亚国家项目官员Suzan Agada在阿布贾作出
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Dr Suzan Agada, National Programme Officer, Women in Leadership and Decision Making, UN Women Nigeria, said this in Abuja on Monday.

key_facts.fact: 活动为纪念国际普遍获取信息日而举办的论坛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that the forum was organised to commemorate the International Day for Universal Access to Information.

key_facts.fact: 为期一年的运动由卡特中心资助
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the one-year campaign, funded by the Carter Center, would use radio, television, billboards and peer-to-peer community engagement to reach women

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
